# cosmoner Provider

Manages resources on [Cosmoner](https://cosmoner.com) through its public API.

Authenticate with a project API key created in the control panel. The key's scopes decide which resources the provider can manage: each resource's page lists the scope it needs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cosmoner = {
      source = "datablock-dev/cosmoner"
    }
  }
}

# Reads COSMONER_API_KEY, COSMONER_PROJECT_ID and COSMONER_API_URL from the
# environment, so nothing secret needs to be in configuration.
provider "cosmoner" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key to authenticate with. Falls back to the `COSMONER_API_KEY` environment variable, which is the better place for it: a key in configuration ends up in version control.
- `api_url` (String) Base URL of the API. Falls back to the `COSMONER_API_URL` environment variable, then to `https://api.cosmoner.com`.
- `max_retries` (Number) How many times a request is retried after a rate limit, or after a server or network failure on a request that is safe to repeat. Defaults to `2`.
- `project_id` (String) Project that resources are created in when they do not set `project_id` themselves. Falls back to the `COSMONER_PROJECT_ID` environment variable.
